title: Eisenhower Farewell Address (Best Quality) - 'Military Industrial Complex' WARNING
summary: A high-quality recording of President Eisenhower's January 1961 farewell address, including his warning about the unwarranted influence of the military-industrial complex. The uploader marks the key passage at 8:41.
why: HN commenters link it as the primary source for the phrase 'military-industrial complex' and urge people to hear the full speech rather than the soundbite.

quote.text: Eisenhower's 1961 Farewell Address is misinterpreted by many and totally forgotten by others. Please listen
